description:
An AI assistant for working with the office documents on your computer.

NCurator is a local-first AI assistant built around the office documents on your own computer.
- Office document work: read, create and edit DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and plain-text files, and read PDFs.
- Local knowledge base: index large numbers of files, retrieve content, and cite the sources.
- Web search: search the web, read pages, and drive the built-in browser.
- Local terminal: run local commands and scripts for data processing and task automation.
- Change review: inspect revision history, review diffs, and roll back supported file changes.
- WPS integration: click a change to open the document in WPS at that position, and refresh the document after AI edits or rollbacks.
- Scheduled tasks: run tasks on a schedule and reuse a partner's models and configuration.
New features
- Added long-term partner memory with direct editing, change review, and controls for syncing user information and task experience.
- Added a formatting toolbar and search for Word, improved selection references and change navigation, and expanded AI support for comments, headers, footers, and sections.
- Improved in-app Excel editing and Office file saving, with a preference for viewing changes in the app or WPS.
- Added interactive HTML previews and video playback with automatic conversion for unsupported videos, and improved media presentation in conversations.
- Improved conversation navigation, reply copying and completion times, context usage display, and question notifications; refined network retries and task interruption messages after system sleep.
- Workspace folders now remember their expanded state and consistently hide dependency and virtual environment folders, with clearer history-clearing prompts and more visible icons.
Bug fixes
- Fixed the Word color palette staying open when reselecting the current color.
- Fixed date formula calculation when reviewing Excel workbooks using the 1904 date system.
- Fixed issues with multiline memory editing and review on Windows.
- Fixed local file, image, and video references inside dot-prefixed folders appearing unavailable.
- Fixed source reference insertion failing after document previews refreshed.
